title: Swipe between screens
summary: A normal horizontal swipe now moves between roster tabs on a phone.
changes: Swipe across the noninteractive content of Night, Changes and Breaks or across the bottom tab bar to move one tab at a time.
Real touch handling fixes the tab-bar gesture that did not respond reliably, while vertical scrolling, controls, dialogs, selected text and Chat conversations keep their usual interactions.
The roster rules, Supabase data and PWA update flow remain unchanged.
